capabilities: Draw pinyin above Chinese characters in Reading view and Live Preview
Choose the correct reading for characters with several readings based on their word
Style tones as marks, numbers or colors, or show zhuyin instead
Hide pinyin in practice mode until a character is pointed at or tapped
Fix a reading for a word and hide pinyin for characters already known
disambiguation: Not a Chinese input method; it only draws pinyin above Chinese text already written in your notes.
extras: No network use; the dictionary ships with the plugin. Settings and corrections are saved in the plugin's data.json, and the per-note toggle writes a pinyin property to that note. Part of the Tahoe family of plugins and a theme.
intentEvidence: Tahoe Pinyin needs no code blocks: it works on the Chinese anywhere in your notes
problem: Chinese text in notes gives no pronunciation help, and other pinyin plugins require code blocks or span markers around the text.

relations.evidence: Tahoe Pinyin needs no code blocks: it works on the Chinese anywhere in your notes, while you edit too.
Tahoe Pinyin needs no markers, and is for Chinese only.
With Tahoe: the pinyin sits in the theme's muted text colour

summary: Renders pinyin or zhuyin above Chinese characters in Reading view and Live Preview, with word-correct readings, tone styles and colors, and a practice mode.
